scenes.name: BREAKFAST
lines: Dublin, October 1843. Every morning at breakfast, Hamilton's sons asked: can you multiply triplets yet?
1843 年 10 月，都柏林。每天早餐，哈密顿的儿子们都问：爸爸，三元数能乘了吗？
He shook his head. No, I can only add and subtract them.
他摇摇头：不能，我只会把它们相加、相减。
Strange. Arrows in space already have a product, the cross product. Why wasn't that enough?
怪了：空间里的箭头明明有乘法，就是叉乘。为什么还不够？

scenes.name: WHAT THE CROSS DROPS
lines: Take two arrows. A is one, two, two, of length three. B is zero, three, four, of length five.
Their cross product stands up out of their plane. Its length is their area, about five point four.
它们的叉乘从两者的平面里竖起来，长度就是两者撑开的面积，约 5.4。
But three times five is fifteen. Where did the rest go?
可 3 乘 5 是 15。剩下的去哪了？
Into the shadow of one arrow on the other: the dot product, fourteen. The cross product throws it away.
去了一支箭头落在另一支上的影子里：点积 14。叉乘把它扔掉了。
Worse, any arrow crossed with itself gives zero. Something nonzero squares to nothing, so you can never divide.
更糟的是：任何箭头与自己叉乘都得零。不为零的东西自乘成了零，于是没法做除法。

scenes.name: AN HONEST RECEIPT
lines: Think of a product as a receipt. An honest one adds up to length times length.
把乘积想成一张收据：老实的收据，总数等于长度乘长度。
Square both lines: one ninety-six plus twenty-nine is two twenty-five, which is fifteen squared.
两行各自平方：196 加 29 得 225，正是 15²。
Lean checks this for any two lists of real numbers.
Lean 内核检验了：对任意两组实数都成立。
Lengths squared, multiplied, minus the dot squared, equal the sum of the squared areas.
长度平方之积减去点积平方，等于各块面积的平方和。
In three dimensions, those areas are the cross product. Dot and cross are two legs of one right triangle.
在三维里，这些面积正是叉乘的分量。点积与叉乘是同一个直角三角形的两条直角边。
So the cross product is not a wrong product. It is half a receipt.
所以叉乘不是错的乘法，它只是半张收据。

scenes.name: ONE MORE LINE
lines: Hamilton's fix was to give the receipt one more line: a plain number, kept beside the arrow.
哈密顿的办法，是给收据添一行：在箭头旁边留一个普通的数。
Multiply a and b again. The number line gets minus fourteen; the arrow lines get the cross product.
再把 a 和 b 乘一次：数的那一行记下 −14，箭头那三行记下叉乘。
Length fifteen, exactly three times five. Nothing leaks. And an arrow squared is now minus nine, not zero.
长度 15，恰好 3 乘 5，一分不漏。箭头自乘现在是 −9，不再是零。
To multiply in three, keep a fourth.
要在三维里乘得拢，就得留住第四行。

scenes.name: THE CROSS IS FORCED
lines: Lean checks a sharper fact. Take one number slot and three arrow slots.
Lean 内核还检验了一件更强的事：取一个数位、三个箭头位。
Any rule for the twisting part that obeys two axioms, positivity and phase balance, must be the cross product, up to one sign.
任何满足正性与相位平衡两条公理的扭转规则，都必定是叉乘，至多差一个整体符号。
And Pauli matrices multiply exactly this way: the dot in the number slot, the cross in the arrow slots.
泡利矩阵正是这样相乘：点积坐在数位上，叉乘坐在箭头位上。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: Theorems of Frobenius and Hurwitz rule out a three-dimensional real number system you can divide in.
弗罗贝尼乌斯与胡尔维茨的定理，排除了实数上能做除法的三维数系。
Those are literature results, not checked in Lean in this book.
这是文献结果，本书没有在 Lean 里检验。
Lean checks the identity, and the forced cross product on its four-slot carrier.
Lean 检验的是那条恒等式，以及四位载体上被锁定的叉乘。
Reading the missing triplet as a closed arc is this book's model, not a theorem.
把缺席的三元数读作闭合的圆弧体，是本书的模型，不是定理。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter thirty-two.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第三十二章
